{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000004CQWRMJWDE84R","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x256
group plugin "Plugin" {
  node PAssist "plugin-assistant" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-assistant" color=blue
}
group agents "Agents" {
  node Toolkit "assistant-toolkit" ref="packages/core/compute/assistant-toolkit"
  node Assistant "assistant" ref="packages/core/compute/assistant"
  node Conductor "conductor" ref="packages/core/compute/conductor"
  node AgentRt "agent-runtime" ref="packages/core/compute/agent-runtime"
  node Ai "ai" ref="packages/core/compute/ai" color=violet
  node Mcp "mcp-client" ref="packages/core/compute/mcp-client"
}
group runtime "Runtime" color=light-violet {
  node Runtime "compute-runtime" ref="packages/core/compute/compute-runtime" color=light-red
  node Compute "compute" ref="packages/core/compute/compute"
  node Operation "operation" ref="packages/core/compute/operation"
  node EdgeCompute "edge-compute" ref="packages/core/compute/edge-compute" color=orange
  node EchoClient "echo-client" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client" color=green
}
edge PAssist -> Toolkit
edge PAssist -> Assistant
edge PAssist -> Conductor
edge Toolkit -> AgentRt
edge Assistant -> Ai "LLM"
edge Assistant -> Mcp "tools"
edge AgentRt -> Runtime
edge Runtime -> Compute
edge Operation -> Compute
edge Runtime -> EchoClient
edge EdgeCompute -> Runtime "remote functions"
"},"objects":[
